title: Linear SVM with Hinge-Loss Subgradient Descent
signature: def linear_svm(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, lam: float, n_iters: int) -> tuple
hints: A sample contributes to the hinge subgradient only if its margin y_i (w . x_i + b) is strictly below 1.
Average the hinge part over all n samples, including the inactive ones, then add lam * w. The bias gets no lam * b term.
The step size on iteration t (counting from 1) is 1 / (lam * t).
